## Submission checklist

- [ ] Source code is publicly visible at the link above
- [ ] The plugin only uses `condenser:api`, `react`, and Node built-ins — no network calls to third-party services without disclosure
- [ ] The GitHub Release URL in the version YAML matches a real published release
- [ ] `sha256` in the YAML matches the actual zip (`sha256sum your-plugin.zip`)
- [ ] `index.jpg` screenshot is included and shows the plugin running in Steam
- [ ] `author` field points to a real author entry in `resources/authors/`
- [ ] Version follows semver (`1.0.0`)
